data.rationale: Federal Bank is positioned for steady improvement from current levels. Loan growth forecasted at 14-15% near-term (above Q3's 9% but below deposit growth of 15%), normalizing to 12% by FY30E as base expands. NIM expansion path from current 3.18% to 3.40% driven by CASA improvement (44.4% to 48%) and favorable liability mix, despite rate cycle headwinds in FY26E. Credit costs improving sharply from management's revised 52-53bps guidance for FY26E toward normalized 45bps by FY30E, reflecting decadal-best asset quality (GNPA 1.72%, NNPA 0.42%, PCR 75%). Cost-to-income gradually improves from current 53.9% to 48% through operating leverage and digital initiatives, though pace is measured given calibrated branch expansion. ROA progression from current 1.15% to 1.50% and ROE from 11.68% to 15.5% reflects combined benefit of NIM expansion, lower credit costs, and improved efficiency, while maintaining strong capital adequacy (current CAR 15.2%). Conservative trajectory accounts for competitive pressures in retail banking and regulatory environment.
